title: Hand-cricket
tagline: A simple hand cricket game on frames, where users can score 1,2,4,6 runs by frame buttons and there will be computer who plays as opponents, and this game is fun to play.
description: A simple hand cricket game where users can play with a computer, first there will be a toss, after that user or computer will bat first, there will be 4 buttons in the frame, they are 1,2,4,6 as they are mostly scored in the cricket. If the user bats first, he will choose a random button, if the same number is chosen by the computer. then the user will out and vice versa. And there will be second innings where the players switch position. Go and play and have fun.
how_its_made: To build this project, I used frames.js and nextjs, they are pieced together by vercel. I really loved frames. I used typescript, react technologies to build this project. After learning Next js, I made this project. I really loved the hackathon so much. The techonology we are using right now, this frames are going to the future.
